title: How to Photograph Vintage and Antique Items So They Actually Sell
description: Vintage sellers know condition sells. Here's how to photograph age, patina, and character in ways that maximize price.

blocks.text: Vintage and antique buyers want to see age. Wear. Patina. Character. But they also want a clean, professional listing that doesn't scream "grandma's estate sale."
Balancing both is the vintage seller's art.
What Vintage Buyers Want to See
Nail all five and you can charge 3-5x more than sloppy vintage listings.
The Clean-Background Rule Still Applies
Even vintage items sell better on clean backgrounds. The item itself provides the "vintage vibe"—your background shouldn't compete.

Use edit-photo to remove the background and export a transparent PNG. Create white or branded layout versions with the site's supported main-image workflow or a separate design editor; capture and color correction still need to be handled before or after background removal.
The Patina vs Damage Distinction
Photograph patina as feature: even lighting on the aged surface, warm tones, subtle detail.
Photograph damage as disclosure: harsh direct lighting on chips, cracks, missing pieces, clearly labeled.
Buyers reward both. They just want to see them separately.
The Detail Shot Priority
Vintage listings need obsessive detail shots:
Each shot deserves clean background editing at edit-photo.com. Buyers zoom in—messy backgrounds make you look untrustworthy.
The Scale Non-Negotiable
Vintage buyers hate size surprises. Include:

items.text: Item next to a common object (coin, ruler, book)
Item measured with a tape/ruler in-frame

blocks.text: Use Rights-Safe Source Images

If a source image contains a watermark, obtain an unwatermarked file from the rights holder or create your own photo. edit-photo does not remove watermarks, and removing ownership marks without permission can create legal and marketplace risks.
The Storytelling Angle
Vintage sells on story. Include (optional but powerful):

items.text: Item in a curated antique setting
Item styled for a specific aesthetic (mid-century, art deco, farmhouse)

blocks.text: Export a transparent PNG from edit-photo, then place it into the final scene or layout with a general design editor. Keep the original and transparent master so the composition remains reversible.
The Etsy vs eBay Question

Etsy: Aesthetic and story matter. Curated photos win.
eBay: Detail and honesty matter. Clinical photos win.
Same item, two different photo approaches. Both use edit-photo.com for consistent editing.
